🎬: Spider-Noir (2026)

Set in 1930s New York, private investigator Spider-Man Noir is a hardened, mysterious hero haunted by his violent past. When a new case pulls him into the city’s criminal underworld, he finds himself caught between corrupt officials, dangerous gangsters, and a growing conspiracy that threatens everything he has left.

As the investigation deepens, Noir is forced to confront his own demons while fighting for justice in a city where almost everyone has something to hide. Blending gritty detective noir with Spider-Man’s supernatural edge, the series follows his brutal journey through a world of crime, secrets, and redemption.

source_details.synopsis: Spider-Noir is an American superhero television series developed by Oren Uziel for MGM+ and Prime Video. Based on Marvel Comics featuring the character Spider-Man Noir, the series follows an aging private investigator and superhero in 1930s New York City grappling with his past. Uziel and Steve Lightfoot serve as the series showrunners. Produced by Sony Pictures Television in association with Amazon MGM Studios, Spider-Noir is set in an alternate universe within the Sony's Spider-Man Universe (SSU) franchise. Nicolas Cage stars as Ben Reilly / The Spider in his first lead role in a television series, with Lamorne Morris, Li Jun Li, Karen Rodriguez, Abraham Popoola, Jack Huston, and Brendan G
